Description: Libby is a small mountain town in northwestern Montana's Kootenai Valley, featuring an in-city VA clinic, abundant outdoor recreation in the Kootenai National Forest and Cabinet Mountains Wilderness, and affordable housing relative to Western Montana. The tradeoffs include isolation from major regional hubs, snowy winters, and a historical asbestos mining legacy under long-term EPA remediation.
